verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Devin takes plain-language requests to implement new features, reproduce and fix bugs, and handle migrations and refactors, through a conversational UI, Slack/Teams threads, or the CLI. Hands-on community reports confirm it gets real work done, though one trial notes it adds extraneous changes beyond the task, which is a reliability caveat rather than a contradiction. missing for 10: explicit documentation of multi-file edit scope (only implied by refactors/migrations), independent corroboration of reliable feature/bug-fix quality without scope creep.
